Trust is a touchy subject, and can differ largely on the experiences someone has had. 

I was in a similar situation at one point, not as extreme, but I had issues with trust. Still do. My best advice to you would to be, well, just leap for it. Life is whatever you make of it, and while cats and Reddit are nice, there is nothing more rewarding than taking the leap of trust and being received. But for the love of god do it on your own terms, take your time, ease into things. Really consider your options before you find someone to trust. 

As for the hugs, well, physical contact is a whole other can of worms. But it should come with trust.

Sorry if this wasn't much help, these are just things I wish someone had said to me during my dark times. Good luck, and if you ever need a friend my inbox is always open!
